title: Descent
blurb: Six-degrees-of-freedom shooter through mining tunnels. Shareware demo.

title: Raptor: Call of the Shadows
blurb: Apogee's slick vertical shooter with a between-mission cash shop. Shareware.
note: Shareware ep1. Executable is RAP.EXE + FILE0000/0001.GLB. Extracted from PKLITE .SHR self-installer at build time.
